study: Round 5 (full spec received 14:40 ET): T4 mark/get set/go, T1 horizon ladder, T3 calendar, T2 earnings drift, T5 news
rules: free data only (historical SIP bars, Alpaca news, Finnhub free endpoints with the desk key read-only, never printed); read-only; nice 15; <= 1 request/s total; max 2 heavy jobs
costs: full round-trip modeled spread (round-2 U2 SpreadModel at the entry minute; daily tests use the symbol's median) + 2 bp for any overnight or open-print leg (next-open entries, 1-day/5-day holds). Limit fills pay only the exit half-spread (+2 bp if overnight).
baselines: random picks from the same universe on the same dates (same minute for intraday); report raw net, excess vs random, and minus-SPY; t clustered by date

splits.daily_T1_T2_T3: by time over the available daily history: oldest 60% tune, next 20% validate, newest 20% holdout (holdout run once)

T4.universe: U2 liquid 108 (Mark ranks the 108 names; SPY itself excluded from Mark picks? no: all 108 ranked, as specified)
T4.mark: before the open of day d: top decile (11 names) of the 108 by 60-day return close(d-1)/close(d-61)-1, tie-break 20-day return; only if SPY close(d-1) > SMA50(d-1); daily closes = last RTH 1-min SIP close (raw prices, split-consistent within the window)
T4.get_set: first 1-min bar close between 10:00 and 11:00 (bars closing 10:00..11:00) with SIP close > session VWAP AND return since the 09:30 open > SPY's return since its 09:30 open
T4.go_wr: after get set, first bar (closing by 11:30) where unsmoothed Williams %R(14) on SIP 1-min crosses up through -50 (prev <= -50 < now); enter at the next 1-min open
T4.go_pullback: after get set, buy limit at get-set close x (1 - 10 bp); fills if a SIP 1-min low trades strictly below within the next 10 bars; fill at the limit
T4.stages: Mark-only = buy 09:45 open (open of the 09:45 bar); Mark+Set = open of the bar after get set; Mark+Set+Go(%R); Mark+Set+Go(pullback)
T4.holds: 30 min, 60 min (close of the bar 30/60 minutes after entry), 15:50 (close of the 15:49 bar), 1 day (next session's last RTH close), 5 days (5th session's last RTH close)
T4.one_trade: per name per day per stage
T4.random: 5 random U2 names (not marked that day) entered at the same minute with the same hold and cost rule
T4.second_variant: if T1/T2 finds a clearly better pre-open selection on tune+validate, rerun T4 with it as Mark (labeled variant 2)

T1.universe: U2 108 (SURVIVORSHIP: today's list applied back in time); daily SIP bars (split+dividend adjusted) as far back as served; broader set not attempted (no point-in-time membership)

signals.RS12_1: top decile return from t-252 to t-21
signals.PULLBACK: close > SMA50 and (RSI(2) < 10 or 3 consecutive down closes)

T1.selection: equal-weight top N = 5 and 10 by the signal's ranking variable (RS: return; NEAR_HIGH: distance to high; PULLBACK: RSI(2) ascending) among qualifying names
T1.regime: none / SPY close > SMA50 / SPY close > SMA200 (all at signal close)
T1.report: per-trade net bp and daily-portfolio bp (mean over signal dates of the equal-weight basket), excess vs random N names same date, minus-SPY
T1.promotion: net excess vs random > 0 on tune AND validate and date-clustered t >= 2 on tune+validate; holdout once for the best <= 5

T3.assets: SPY, QQQ, last 5 years of daily bars
effects: turn of month: last trading day through 3rd trading day, close-to-close vs other days
pre-holiday: trading day before an exchange holiday (weekday gap)
T3.cost: +1 round trip (SPY/QQQ model spread) + 2 bp overnight leg where applicable

T2.data: Finnhub free /stock/earnings (EPS actual vs estimate, period) and /calendar/earnings where history exists; reaction day = first session after the report (BMO -> same day, AMC -> next)
T2.signals: top-quintile reaction-day return among reports; EPS surprise > 0
